players.product: Niche DRAM (DDR4, DDR3L, LPDDR4X) plus NOR flash and SLC NAND flash (fabless)

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company says all the memory products it sells face tight supply with prices rising accordingly. In DRAM, its niche DRAM keeps benefiting from the leading makers' output cuts and exit; in 2026 it will push customer introduction of DDR4 8Gb and other products at TV, industrial (e.g. power) customers and AI-related applications, bring LPDDR4 products to mass production and develop small-capacity LPDDR5. In customised memory, after some projects entered customer sampling and small-batch trial production in H2 2025, it will push chips into mass production in car cockpits, AI PCs and robots in 2026 and contribute a certain amount of revenue. In Flash it will keep raising NOR Flash share in automotive, computing, edge AI and overseas markets.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 plan: DDR4 8Gb customer introduction; LPDDR4 mass production; small-capacity LPDDR5 R&D; customised memory to mass production in 2026
